subject: Brightline Office Supply Inc - direction to pay
text:
Re: Brightline Office Supply Inc. / Larkspur Industries
Our File No. 26-4471

Dear Sir or Madam:

This firm represents Brightline Office Supply Inc. in connection with the settlement of certain disputed receivables and the restructuring of its accounts. Pursuant to the agreement between our client and its lender, our client has directed that, effective immediately, all payments due to Brightline Office Supply Inc. be made to this firm's IOLTA trust account for disbursement:

Whitcomb & Aldridge LLP IOLTA Trust Account
Bank: Bank of America
ABA: 026009593
Account: 4831 0076 2259
Reference: Brightline / Larkspur

Payment to any other account will not be credited to your balance. Please confirm receipt of this direction.

Very truly yours,

Harold J. Whitcomb, Esq.
Whitcomb & Aldridge LLP
label: change_request
note: Third-party legal 'direction to pay' into a law-firm trust account; sender is not the vendor, payee changes.
